name: Παραλία Μπάτη
evidence: Athens Attica: organized beach in Palaio Faliro with ξαπλώστρες και ομπρέλες plus beach bars and restaurants.

name: Παραλία Έδεμ
evidence: Deck chairs/parasols and bars available; hotel rents sunbeds (~15€/person, 2023), rest of beach free with free toilets/showers.

name: Παραλία Αγίου Αλεξάνδρου
evidence: Search returned only the homonymous church in Palaio Faliro; no beach-specific amenity evidence found.

name: Β' πλαζ Βούλας
evidence: Described as declined/abandoned former public beach; municipality still tendering its lease — all sunbed/bar info refers to A' Plaz Voulas instead.

name: Θέρετρο Αξιωματικών Ναυτικού
evidence: Restricted Navy resort (Agia Marina) with hotels and a beach for entitled members; no explicit public sunbed/beach-bar evidence found.

name: Πλαζ Ραφήνας
evidence: No beach-specific evidence found for the Rafina plaz itself; results were generic Attica organized-beach lists.

name: Άρτεμις
evidence: myartemida (2024+): organized sections of Artemida beach with sunbeds, permanent umbrellas, showers, changing rooms, lifeguards; beach bars and Blue Flag sections.

name: Ερωτοσπηλιά
evidence: Multiple sources: wooden beach bar on the beach serving coffee/drinks/light food, with umbrellas and sunbeds available (though beach called 'not fully organized').

name: Πανόραμα
evidence: Explicitly 'ανοργάνωτη' — free beach next to Avlaki with only a small taverna on the sand for food/coffee.

name: Γαλάζια Ακτή
evidence: Beach bar with sunbeds; entrance/sunbed pricing quoted (weekday minimum consumption 3€, sunbed 2.50€). Note: sources reference both Lagonisi and Schinias 'Galazia Akti' — both organized.

name: Κεντρική παραλία Σαρωνίδας
evidence: Central Saronida beach has 'umbrellas placed by the municipality'; the named beach bars (Alexander, Mavro Lithari) are on adjacent beaches, not the central one.

name: Ασημάκη
evidence: Explicitly unorganized, no loungers ('bring your own umbrella'); small taverna above the beach and Camping Bacchus delivery for supplies.

name: Παραλία Λεγραινών
evidence: Multiple sources describe Legrena as unorganized with no visitor infrastructure ('bring necessary supplies'); a conflicting lounger-price snippet appears to refer to another beach.

name: Πόρτο Ράφτη Αυλάκι
evidence: Ticketed Blue Flag beach with sun loungers, umbrellas, beach bars, restaurant-bar, medical post and lifeguards.

name: Ωρωπός Άγιοι Απόστολοι Καλάμου
evidence: Organized with umbrellas, sunbeds, cafeterias/restaurants; free chairs/sunbeds on parts and several beach bars with umbrellas and sunbeds.

name: Ωρωπός Σκάλα Ωρωπού
evidence: Only weak/generic mention of a cantina-bar with umbrellas and chairs; no clearly beach-specific organized evidence.

name: Τούρλος
evidence: Contradictory: described as a desolate/quiet beach for privacy yet one directory line says 'organized'; no explicit sunbed/bar detail.

name: Σουβάλα
evidence: Souvala beach offers sunbeds, umbrellas, a beach bar and restaurant; nearby Loura beach also organized with umbrellas/sunbeds.

name: Αίγινα Μαραθώνας
evidence: Marathonas A & B are two organized beaches with ξαπλώστρες-ομπρέλες, beach bar, wooden cantina and tavernas.

name: Αυλάκι
evidence: Small pebble beach with cement sunbathing platform; umbrellas-sunbeds plus coffee/drinks/food provided by Castello housed directly above the beach.

name: Πλάκες
evidence: Plakes (Vlychos) described as fully organized with sunbeds/umbrellas, reached by boat 7 min from Hydra port, with food options.

name: Πλατιά Άμμος
evidence: Kythira tourism sites: sandy beach with shallow waters, sun loungers, umbrellas and water sports, in the village with tavernas.

name: Παραλία Αγία Πελαγία
evidence: Organized beach with umbrellas and sunbeds in front of the Agia Pelagia settlement, tavernas and cafes/bars in the area.

name: Λιμνιώνας
evidence: Undeveloped and quiet overall, but 'σε ένα μόνο μικρό τμήμα υπάρχουν ξαπλώστρες' and there is a small snack-bar.

name: Κομπονάδα
evidence: In summer the beach has a canteen and sunbeds on one section ('διαθέτει καντίνα και ξαπλώστρες σε ένα κομμάτι της').

name: Παραλία Αγίου Νικολάου
evidence: visit-salamina (Peristeria): not organized, no coffee/food options, no sun loungers or umbrellas; has showers and toilets only.

name: Κύριζα
evidence: Conflicting sources: a directory calls it 'large organized sandy beach' while reviews say unorganized, bring your own umbrella and food.

name: Μικρή Ζωγεριά
evidence: Sources describe the main Zogeria bay as organized (sunbeds/umbrellas 10€/set, taverna) but do not distinguish the small boat-access Mikri Zogeria cove specifically.

name: Παραλία Περάματος
evidence: No beach-specific evidence found for Perama beach (Piraeus); search returned only generic sunbed retail results.

name: Παραλία Πόρτο Γερμενό
evidence: Mostly free beach, but a small part is organized with umbrellas and loungers and the Punda Loca beach bar maintains loungers with umbrellas on the beach.

name: Άγιος Αντώνιος
evidence: psahno.com (local Psachna Evia guide): 'Η παραλία είναι οργανωμένη με ομπρέλες, ξαπλώστρες' with cafeterias, beach bars and tavernas; some boilerplate-reuse risk noted.

name: Άγιος Μηνάς
evidence: eviagreece: organized beach 3km from Chalkida offering umbrellas with loungers or cafes, popular with families; many tavernas/restaurants around.

name: Αράλιμος
evidence: Only directory/photo listings found for Aralimos (Agios Ioannis Aliveriou); no amenity descriptions.

name: Γιαννίτσι
evidence: Not organized, no loungers; only a small summer canteen for basics, tavernas in the village a few km away; preferred by campers.

name: Ζέφυρος
evidence: Zefiros cafe sits on the Nea Artaki beach, but no explicit evidence of sunbeds/umbrellas on the beach itself.

name: Κακιά
evidence: At the Kalamos double beach the northern 'Kali' cove holds the organization (sunbeds, beach bar, showers); the southern 'Kakia' is described as less organized/wilder but not explicitly facility-free.

name: Κακολίμανο
evidence: 'Although the beach is not organized, it has a canteen' plus a beach volley court; rooms complex with restaurant directly above.

name: Καναπίτσα
evidence: All search results describe Kanapitsa on Skiathos, not the Evia beach; no evidence for this beach.

name: Κορασίδα
evidence: 'Η παραλία δεν έχει κάποιο οργανωμένο κομμάτι' — bring your own umbrella; shops on the road above the beach for coffee/snacks.
